title: Channel A — cloud REST (device <-> cloud, HTTP/HTTPS)
description: Base URL default https://mobile.proscenic.cn/ (stored in /data/bin/Run/Config/url). REQUESTS are application/x-www-form-urlencoded (modeled here as objects = field sets). RESPONSES are JSON with the common envelope. No TLS validation on the device; firmware blobs fetch over plain HTTP from the OSS host.

register_response.description: On code==0, data MUST contain 'session' and 'cookies' (NOT a field named 'token'). Verified: device strncpy's data.session (0x40) and data.cookies (0x38); log 'mSession:%s\tmCookies:%s'; missing => 'no session!!!' and endless re-register.

session.description: AES key material; session[:16] = Channel-B AES-128-ECB key

cookies.description: sid value; device returns it on every Channel-A request as HTTP header 'Cookie: cookies=<value>'

sync_response.description: code 0=ok; 102/212=sid expired. Live server currently returns {code:102,message:'你的sid过期啦'}

downUrl.description: firmware URL on the OSS host (robotDrivers/<ms-ts>)

md5.description: transport MD5 of the whole downloaded firmware.bin (NOT the RSA-signed body md5)

report_body.description: Channel-A POST bodies (form-urlencoded) vary by endpoint; 'data' is ALWAYS PLAINTEXT JSON (device->cloud is not encrypted), not always URL-escaped. Verified templates: 'sn=%s&ts=%llu&data=%s', 'sn=%s&ts=%lu&data=%s', 'sn=%s&infoType=%d&ts=%s&userId=%s&data=<json>', 'devType=3&sn=%s&taskid=%llu&event=%d&createtime=%d&data=%s' (uploadEvents), 'devType=3&sn=%s&ts=%s&qid=%s'. A server must accept these extra fields, not only sn/ts/data.

ts.description: epoch (ms or s depending on template)

getSockAddr_request.description: POST /cleanPack/getSockAddr. Cookie-authenticated (sent after register, carries 'Cookie: cookies=<sid>'). Exact body fields NOT fully verified (gap) — likely include sn; do not require unknown fields. Confirm from a live capture.
